title: Alien bodies studied in secret by biologists

tellings.quote: I know now that we have bodies here that we have biologists have studied here and that those studies are ended.
genetics studies or the uh studies that have been done on tissue of these beings that have been recovered. Uh I think that has been done.
tellings.difference: Salas speaks of tissue and genetics studies, as an impression he heard second hand, and does not say the studies have ended.
tellings.link_reason: Both are general claims that the bodies of recovered beings have been studied biologically in secret.

plain: This story claims that the United States holds the bodies of non-human beings and has had biologists study them in secret. A writer named Whitley Strieber says he knows there are such bodies here, that biologists studied them, and that those studies have ended. A former Air Force officer, Robert Salas, says he believes studies have been done on the tissue and genetics of recovered beings, though he gives this as an impression and does not say the work stopped. If true, it would mean physical proof of other beings already sits in government hands.
